name: Inverse-Volatility Weighted Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Weekly-rebalanced inverse-volatility portfolio across SPY (equities), TLT (bonds), GLD (gold), and DBC (commodities). Uses 63-day realized volatility to compute inv-vol weights: lower-vol assets receive higher allocations. Rebalances every Monday. Long all 4 assets at all times — pure rotation, no stops. Measures risk-adjusted returns and drawdowns via auto-generated tearsheet.
source:
# Inverse-Volatility Weighted Portfolio
# Universe: SPY (equities), TLT (bonds), GLD (gold), DBC (commodities)
# Signal: 63-day realized annualized volatility (inv-vol weighting)
# Rebalance: Weekly (first trading day of each week)
# Direction: Always long all 4 assets — pure rotation, no stops
#
# Weight formula: w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j)
# Lower-volatility assets (typically TLT/GLD) receive higher allocations.
# Higher-volatility assets (typically DBC/SPY) receive lower allocations.

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Volatility Signal ---
# 63-day realized annualized volatility (feeds close prices directly — S47)
vol_63d = volatility(period=63)(close)

# --- Rebalance Trigger ---
# First trading day of each week
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# --- Inv-Vol Weights ---
# Cross-sectional: w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j) across all 4 assets
# inv_vol_weight handles the normalization automatically
weights = inv_vol_weight()(volatility=vol_63d)

# --- Entry Signal ---
# Always long — enter on first bar with valid vol, hold forever
# Use hold_until with a permanent enter (True once vol is valid) and no exit
has_vol = is_valid(vol_63d)
held = hold_until()(enter=has_vol, exit=False)

# --- Execution (wiring order: zone → sizing) ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Position sizing: inv-vol weight × 100 = percent of equity
# Rebalance only on first trading day of each week to avoid daily churn
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
